_meta.note: analysis layers — planning heuristics, constants in pipeline/shared.js; raw pulls with per-source provenance in pipeline/raw/

sources.source: NASA POWER climatology, parameter ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN (all-sky surface shortwave downward irradiance), community=AG, units MJ/m2/day, custom climatology years 2001-2020
sources.method: Regional climatology API fetched in 10x10-deg JSON tiles (native 1x1-deg solar grid); each 0.5x0.625-deg MERRA-2 cell mapped to its containing 1-deg solar cell (center = floor(coord)+0.5, matching the site's compiled December DLI); DLI = ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN x 0.45 x 4.57, rounded to 1 decimal (mol/m2/day)

sources.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, EIA-861 Annual Electric Power Industry Report — 2024 Sales, Revenue and Price summary, Table 5.C (Average Monthly Bill, Industrial sector, by state)
sources.vintage: 2024 (final annual EIA-861 data; most recent complete year)
sources.method: Downloaded xlsx via Python urllib, parsed with openpyxl; extracted 'Average Price (cents/kWh)' column for the 50 states + DC, skipping census-division and U.S. Total aggregate rows; values rounded to 2 decimals. Note: the legacy https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/state/avgprice_annual.xlsx file is stale (ends at 2020), so the current EIA-861 summary table was used instead. Puerto Rico is not published in this table. U.S. Total industrial avg for cross-check: 8.13 cents/kWh.

sources.source: US Census Bureau cartographic boundary file, states, 1:20,000,000 (cb_2023_us_state_20m), shapefile parsed with stdlib struct/zipfile; point-in-polygon via ray casting on cell center with corner-inset fallback (+/-0.2 lat, +/-0.25 lon)
sources.method: center point-in-polygon; if no hit, first hit among 4 corner-inset points in order (+0.2,-0.25),(+0.2,+0.25),(-0.2,-0.25),(-0.2,+0.25); else null

sources.source: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 provincial rankings (Aqueduct40_rankings_download_Y2023M07D05.xlsx, sheet province_baseline, indicator=bws, weight=Tot)
sources.method: downloaded official WRI zip, parsed xlsx with openpyxl
sources.notes: HI has no baseline water stress value in Aqueduct 4.0 provincial rankings (source value -9999/NoData); score set to null. Puerto Rico is not present in the Aqueduct 4.0 provincial or country rankings dataset.

sources.source: Summit Carbon Solutions newsroom (May 13 2026 update), Iowa Capital Dispatch, North Dakota Monitor, South Dakota Ag Connection, DTN/Progressive Farmer, Bleeding Heartland, CURE MN, PR Newswire, Agweek, Bismarck Tribune, Ethanol Producer Magazine, Taxpayers for Common Sense
sources.vintage: operating status and Summit contract book as of mid-2026; current config = 27-plant Iowa route announced 2026-05-13
sources.method: web search + fetch of Summit/news/regulatory sources; matched to updraft/data/facilities.json ethanol rows by state + name similarity, ambiguous multi-plant owners (Valero, Glacial Lakes, ADM, Andersons) resolved by row lon/lat vs plant city coordinates

sources.source: ASHRAE Handbook -- Fundamentals 2025, Chapter 14 Climatic Design Information (99% annual heating dry-bulb), as republished in the .ddy design-condition files of climate.onebuilding.org TMYx.2011-2025 station packages. Each DDY header states: Data Source="2025 ASHRAE Handbook -- Fundamentals - Chapter 14 Climatic Design Information".
sources.method: Downloaded each station's TMYx.2011-2025 zip from climate.onebuilding.org via Python urllib, extracted the .ddy file, parsed the 'Ann Htg 99% Condns DB' SizingPeriod:DesignDay Maximum Dry-Bulb Temperature {C} (cross-checked against the DDY header line 'Annual Heating 99%, MaxDB=').
